name: Wendel Weichel — parents Jacob and Josefine (1926 Saskatchewan census)
researcher_question: Who were the parents of Wendel Weichel (b. 1912, d. 1980, Odessa, Saskatchewan) — in particular his mother, whom the tree does not name?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 4, hint-samples.csv row 155, flag adds_mother, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-09-09: true match. The hint record ark:/61903/1:1:QP51-QH2Y (Canada, Prairie Provinces, Census, 1926, Weyburn No. 67, Saskatchewan) names the mother Josefine, b. 7 September 1891 Russia. The index's Weishel/Weichel surname split is an indexing artifact — the image shows one consistent hand. The census's Jacob fills the tree's unnamed placeholder father GX6M-5HT rather than competing with it. Only the mother finding is required; father, residence and siblings are bonuses. See README 'Notes for reviewers'.
